experiments.mechanism: Execute maintained LSH allocation, sorted fill, retrieval, batched GQA routing, clear and destruction against an independent distinct-table collision oracle.

conditions.execution: portable CPU; optional capability-gated actual AVX512F integer copy body; OpenMP pragmas ignored in serial compilation
conditions.adapter: Explicit non-owning contiguous torch::Tensor/storage and class-declaration substitute; std::copy_n replaces AVX512 copy in portable mode
conditions.seed: fixed literal collision patterns; no RNG
conditions.configuration: K=2, L=4, 2 layers, batch=2, 4 attention heads, 2 KV heads, capacity=35; 3 independent lifetimes, 2 fill/clear generations
conditions.oracle: Examine every unsorted token's literal hash vector; accept exactly when at least two distinct table coordinates equal the query. Compare candidate sets and uniqueness, not incidental output order.
conditions.contracts: 0/1/2/3/4 hits, all collisions, empty buckets, output bounds/canaries, GQA/batch/layer isolation, consecutive-query mask reset, copied input lifetime, clear/refill, get_mask shape/value borrow during owner lifetime and teardown
conditions.preconditions: alloc exactly once; sorted contiguous int16 hashes in [0,2^K), contiguous int32 indices that are per-table permutations of valid token IDs; valid query/layer/head/capacity and divisible GQA dimensions

experiments.note: Valid-input sorted-fill path only. Tensor shim does not establish production Torch dtype/device/contiguity or ABI. get_mask remains non-owning and is never dereferenced after owner destruction. No missing get_table_* definitions are claimed. The historically defective fastfill has a separate Issue66 repair suite; this fixture's subprocess now requires its repaired literal result and clean exit.

experiments.paper_location: Section 4.3 candidate selection; regression for repaired alternate fill path
experiments.mechanism: Dedicated process executes repaired maintained fastfill and requires its independently expected four-token candidate set, normal exit and no sanitizer diagnostic.

conditions.execution: Explicit --fastfill-probe subprocess using maintained repaired body; no known leak is accepted
conditions.fixture: One layer/request/head, K=2, L=4, four tokens all hashing to bucket zero
conditions.oracle: Literal accepted IDs {0,1,2,3}; each ID must appear once after repaired stable token table population
conditions.temporary_ownership: Scoped vector cursors replace historical unfreed bucket allocations
conditions.expected_diagnostic: Exact MAGICPIG-FASTFILL-REPAIRED result marker, zero exit and empty stderr; sanitizer-enabled leak checks record clean, ordinary or explicitly leak-disabled runs record not_checked
conditions.local_limit: Explicitly disabled local leak checking does not establish leak freedom; hosted sanitizer validation keeps LeakSanitizer enabled

experiments.note: Support regression for deliberate maintained Issue66 repair, supplementing MAGICPIG-FASTFILL-REPAIR-CPU's independent parity/lifecycle/boundary suite. Historical Issue56/PR70 reproduced {0} and64bytes/four allocations; immutable archive and those commit/CI records retain that evidence. The old expected-defect executable mapping is retired after repair, not claimed to pass on the corrected body. Torch ABI/GPU remain unverified.
